title: Dithering Dumbo Dabbler
statement: A pocket-sized, pearly-pink octopus with enormous ear-like fins, it flaps through a tank of warm amber light and drifting dust-motes, forever distracted by its own curiosity. It pauses to pat each shell, pebble, and swaying frond in a small ceremony of approval, and when it gets overwhelmed by all the choices it blushes lavender and tucks itself inside a teacup.
